title: lane r1: fix-scale gate unconditional; surface-allows-one clause dropped
description: Lane round 1. Lens: SE (F2) (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: the gate requires a failing test unconditionally, contradicting the sibling filing rule's 'where the surface allows one'; race conditions, doc-drift, tooling defects, and build breakage (the suite that cannot run) become ungateable — agents fabricate token failing tests or stall. Citations verified: contract:64, :66 vs :75. Proposed: resolved-candidate — the gate follows the evidence the surface allows, recorded on the finding issue; for a broken verification surface, the recorded failing state IS the red evidence.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the surface-allows-one clause restored at fix scale — the gate follows the evidence the surface allows, recorded on the finding issue; the broken-verification-surface case's recorded failing state is the red evidence with reviews immediately after. Revision: Phase exit by gate bullet.
